extensionAttribute.description: Whether a battery is currently installed (Yes/No), or N/A on desktops.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Battery Installed Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # Reads the BatteryInstalled property from the AppleSmartBattery IOKit class. # Returns "No" on Macs without a battery (desktops).
value=$(/usr/sbin/ioreg -r -c AppleSmartBattery 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk -F'= ' '/"BatteryInstalled" =/ { gsub(/^[ "]+|[ "]+$/, "", $2); print $2; exit }')
echo "<result>${value:-No}</result>"
